_comment: Character models (prototype). Each body keeps the mannequin as an invisible animation driver; the model listed here copies its pose through an IK Retargeter (Tools/build_retargeters.py builds IK_<key> and RTG_Manny_<key> in /Game/WWO/Retarget; rerun it after adding a model). Keys: the flora ids for the player, allies and the character preview, and soldier / swarm / tank for the enemies. scale: the model's size against the mannequin it follows (1 = as authored). hide_slots: material slots to hide (the Paragon heroes' own guns, Kallari's trailing cloth tentacles). grafts: show the procedural flora grafts on the model (they're pinned to the mannequin's bones, so they sit where its body would be). Packs come from Fab (see HANDOFF) and are not in git. Edit and restart the game; no build needed unless you add a model (then rerun the script). models_off: entries parked here are ignored, so those bodies show the plain mannequin (2026-11-11: the three Paragon hero models cost about 2 ms of GPU a frame with 11 players in view on an M4; move an entry back into models to use it again). player_mesh: a skeletal mesh on the mannequin's skeleton that players and bots wear instead of the mannequin (empty or missing = the mannequin).
